name: package-maven/magento-standards
description: PHPCS and PHPStan configurations used by Package Maven (package-maven.com) to test Magento 2 modules

suggest.magento/magento-coding-standard: The Magento2 ruleset the phpcs configuration builds on
suggest.squizlabs/php_codesniffer: Needed to run the phpcs ruleset
suggest.phpstan/phpstan: Needed to run the phpstan configuration
suggest.bitexpert/phpstan-magento: PHPStan extension used when analysing modules inside a Magento installation
